title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_handbook_on_the_pentateuch_by_chris_paris_ytpfy (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_handbook_on_the_pentateuch_by_chris_paris_ytpfy' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine.
